title: Two Arithmetic Progressions
statementMd:
You are given two arithmetic progressions: $*a*_{1}*k* + *b*_{1}$ and $*a*_{2}*l* + *b*_{2}$. Find the number of integers $*x*$ such that $*L* ≤ *x* ≤ *R*$ and $*x* = *a*_{1}*k*' + *b*_{1} = *a*_{2}*l*' + *b*_{2}$, for some integers $*k*', *l*' ≥ 0$.

## Input

The only line contains six integers $*a*_{1}, *b*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *b*_{2}, *L*, *R*$ ($0 < *a*_{1}, *a*_{2} ≤ 2·10^{9},  - 2·10^{9} ≤ *b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, *L*, *R* ≤ 2·10^{9}, *L* ≤ *R*$).

## Output

Print the desired number of integers $*x*$.
